content.text: Lots of 5-year-olds still co-sleep, and it's very fixable at this age. Start by moving gradually. Tonight, do your normal bedtime routine in his own room, then sit on a chair next to his bed until he falls asleep. Every couple of nights, move the chair a bit closer to the door. He gets used to falling asleep in his own bed, and you slowly fade out. Tell him the plan in the afternoon, and let him pick a new nightlight or stuffie to help.
